summary: 6-locale QA of tabbed hero + document titles on landing page (logged out). 4/6 locales fully PASS (en, fr, de, nl). ES and PT: hero H1, tabs, tab-switch CTAs, and native line2 all correct — but document <title> uses a LONGER tagline in pageTitles.json than the H1 (heroSwissTitle1) in landing.json, causing a title/H1 mismatch vs the spec.

integration_issues.issue: ES home <title> is 'Vende, recibe propinas y recauda fondos — en cripto · Dynopay' but expected 'Vende, recibe propinas, recauda — en cripto · Dynopay' (which matches the H1 heroSwissTitle1 in landing.json). pageTitles.json/home_title for ES uses a longer, different tagline than the hero H1.

PT home <title> is 'Venda, receba gorjetas e arrecade fundos — em cripto · Dynopay' but expected 'Venda, receba gorjetas, arrecade — em cripto · Dynopay' (matches PT H1 heroSwissTitle1). pageTitles.json/home_title for PT uses a longer tagline than the hero H1.

action_items: Update langs/locales/es/pageTitles.json home_title (and any default_title mirroring it) to 'Vende, recibe propinas, recauda — en cripto' so the ' · Dynopay' suffix yields the expected title matching heroSwissTitle1.
Update langs/locales/pt/pageTitles.json home_title to 'Venda, receba gorjetas, arrecade — em cripto' to match PT heroSwissTitle1.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplication of source-of-truth: the home tagline lives in BOTH landing.json/heroSwissTitle1 AND pageTitles.json/home_title. They drifted for ES and PT. Consider deriving the document title from a single key (or importing heroSwissTitle1 into the title composition) to prevent future drift.

success_rate.frontend: 4/6 locales fully pass; 2/6 (es, pt) have document-title mismatch only — hero H1, tabs, tab-switch CTAs and line2 all pass natively.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After fixing es/pt pageTitles.json home_title values, re-run the same locale sweep. Use page.add_init_script to set localStorage 'lang' and 'lang_manual'='true' BEFORE goto, wait_until='domcontentloaded', wait ~2.5s for i18n. Use a fresh browser context per locale. All other locales already verified this run.
rca of the issue: pages/_app.tsx (or equivalent Head/title code) resolves the document title via useTranslation('pageTitles') → t('home_title') + ' · Dynopay'. For es and pt, langs/locales/{es,pt}/pageTitles.json home_title contains a LONGER tagline ('...y recauda fondos...' / '...e arrecade fundos...') than the corresponding landing.json/heroSwissTitle1 short form ('...recauda...' / '...arrecade...'). Fix: edit those two pageTitles.json entries to the short form matching heroSwissTitle1. Reproduce: open /?, set localStorage.lang='es' (or 'pt'), reload, inspect document.title vs #hero-heading first line.
